label: copy-phase input v fed back after outputting an early-middle original token (recall_idx 2-4)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and almost entirely (98% of mass) when the input token is v, i.e. the model just output v and it is fed back. Never fires in the original or delimiter phases. It is strongest when that v was original token 1-3 (recall_idx 2-4; recall_idx 3 holds 52% of mass); it is near zero when v was the first original token (recall_idx 1) and weak for late positions. Precision is incomplete: only about 12% of copy-phase v inputs activate, and about half of v inputs at recall_idx 2-4 stay silent, especially in long sequences with many outputs still to go. Small residual activations on fed-back n. Sequence length, digit count, and a w appearing earlier raise the rate somewhat, but none of these conditions cleanly separates active from inactive cases.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: v, n, w, c, u, o; least: p, 0, m, j) and the token being output (most: w, c, n, v, e, q; least: r, p, h, -); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=3, L=4 & t=6, recall_idx=4.
